newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON - MAY 16.
newsitem.headline: RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON - MAY 16.

text.p: These were the main news headlines reported by Lithuania's radio M1 Plus at noon on Friday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.

- President Algirdas Brazauskas returned from his first official visit to Japan on Friday. Brazauskas will give a speech during the official ceremony opening the new residence of the Lithuanian president in the old town of Vilnius.
- The communication ministers of Lithuania and Israel signed on Friday a co-operation agreement in the sectors of communications and post.
